    Numerical kernel of directed primitive deletion #

    This file formalizes the live manuscript's direct vertex--arrow--mesh count. If q vertices are deleted, aH arrows have both endpoints in the deleted part, z arrows cross the boundary, p objects of the deleted factor are tau-projective, newArrows arrows are gained downstairs, and newMeshes meshes are new downstairs, then

    epsilon = 2*q - aH - p - 1,
newMeshes = z - (p - 1),
sigma(A) - sigma(B) = epsilon + newArrows - newMeshes.

    No block inverse or Schur complement enters this count. Nonnegativity is exposed as the two representation-theoretic obligations 0 ≤ epsilon and newMeshes ≤ newArrows.
